description: Free VPN for building a virtual LAN: play LAN games and reach your computers over the internet.
notes: Not portable: this runs the official installer into Program Files. It adds the network adapter
driver RvNetMP60, the service 'Radmin VPN Control Service' (RvControlSvc) and a firewall exception.
Install, update and uninstall from an elevated (admin) shell.
The installer also adds Radmin Viewer 3 (Start menu), a desktop shortcut, and starts the Radmin VPN
window minimized at every logon (HKLM Run key 'RadminVPN'). Turn autostart off in Task Manager if unwanted.
Updates install over the existing copy, so networks and settings are kept.
Only 'scoop uninstall Radmin-VPN' removes Radmin VPN from the system.
A fresh install stops if Radmin VPN is already installed without Scoop. To let Scoop take over that copy,
run $env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' in the same shell and install again.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app installs a driver and a service: run this from an elevated shell."; break }
# A fresh 'scoop install' must not silently take over a copy installed without Scoop; 'scoop update' is not affected.

$existing = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-ItemProperty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -like 'Radmin VPN*' -and $_.PSChildName -match '^\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}$' } | Select-Object -First 1

error "$($existing.DisplayName) ($($existing.DisplayVersion)) is already installed on this system. Uninstall it first, or run `$env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' and install again to let Scoop install over it and manage it from now on."

script: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app runs a driver and a service: run this from an elevated shell."; break }
# On update the new installer upgrades in place; only a real uninstall removes the app.

$entry = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-ItemProperty | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -like 'Radmin VPN*' -and $_.PSChildName -match '^\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}$' } | Select-Object -First 1
warn 'Radmin VPN was not found among installed programs; nothing to remove.'
